wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Mana sapallaykichu kashanki. Kay patapi kaq crisis nisqa botonqa sapa kutilla kashan  —  llamkay otaq textota apachiy 988, chayri 911 nisqata uj urgenciapi.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.resourcesNote.draft: Kay directorioqa, mana mikhunata, wasita ima qhawanchu.

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Qhawarikuyta munanki. 24 horata qallariypi sumaqta qhaway. Qhawarikuyta munanki chayqa, kaypi qhaway.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Documentosniykiqa encriptasqa kashan. Payllapaj wakichisqa kashan; manaraj uj preciota churarqankuchu.

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: Kunanqa kay numeronta salvasun. Yanapawayta munasqaykita tapusqaykimantapis, maypichus munasqaykiman jina qhaway.

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Maypichus tiyakunaykipaq allin lugarta tariy (211 nisqaman wajyachiy, utaq chaypi tiyakunaykipaq yanapaykunata mañakuy)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Kay semanapaq mikhunata maskʼay (211 nisqaman wajyachiy, utaq maypichus mikhunata japʼinanku kasqanta qhaway)

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Manaraq mañakuspaykiqa, oficialniykiwan parollaykipi kachkasqaykimanta chayri pruebapi kachkasqaykimanta parlariy.

phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Jatun llankʼaypi llankʼay, kamachiykiwan chʼampaykunata qhaway, telefonostaqa mana rikuchinchu.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: Qollqeta japʼinapaj, manataj uj preciotapas churarqankuchu.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Qollqe waqaychay patakuna, wasi kamariy planotaq. Groundworkqa wasita qunchu, mayqin providinawanpas llamkʼanchu. Llactapi yanapaypaq, 211 waqyay.
